summary: Validation and append are not serialized, so concurrent CLI calls can commit discipline-violating records
whyMissed: Tests invoke the CLI sequentially and never exercise concurrent writers between the ledger read and append

whyMissed: The concurrency remediation tested competing live processes and normal cleanup but not abnormal holder termination or recovery

summary: Predictable temporary lock paths are not validated for ownership type symlinks or existing permissions

summary: FFI library selection supports glibc Linux and macOS only and can fail during module loading elsewhere

summary: Hardlink safety does not revalidate link counts at the chmod and flock boundaries
whyMissed: The worker tested only a hardlink present before opening and did not account for link-count changes between descriptor snapshot chmod and flock

summary: Lock lifecycle tests depend on a test-only exported append API and time hook

summary: Hardlink TOCTOU remains between the final link-count check and fchmod

summary: Restrictive umask can create a new lock with unusable mode that the same invocation rejects
